verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing states invoicing lets you 'request payments... and let Relay handle the follow-up' and supports recurring invoices, directly claiming automated dunning for overdue invoices. However there's no detail on how follow-up scheduling/reminders work, no support-doc walkthrough, and no independent/community corroboration that this feature works as described in practice. missing for 10: detailed documentation of follow-up cadence/rules, hands-on or community validation of automated chasing actually reducing manual work.
